answer: Assembling that for 199 aliases means 199 times 2 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each quartz escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the forge ledger records every share and the oasis audit reveals the split. A bond must be split across 2 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
